notes: CONTRADICTS the 'no compiler/front end' premise: tools/lctl430.py IS a full Columned-LCTL -> BRIM/1 compiler+verifier (Python); the Make 'image' target uses it to build every deploy/*.brimg. What is absent is a C-native compiler; the 61KB budget counts only C sources + BOOT.lctlc, not the Python tooling.

Production .build/brctl refuses to run/verify ANY shipped image (raw load compiled out; BRTM/1 trust chain has no CLI provisioning path). Reference/fabric execution uses .build/brctl-dev (raw load enabled via -DBR_DEVELOPMENT=1).
The CLI surfaces only R2.low64; current 4.5/4.6/4.7 boot images write R0 so their R2 reads 0. Author programs must target R2 and declare/gate caps at index 0 (C0:CAP).
Cross-lineage: 5.0.0 images (ABI 1.0/ISA marker 20/32-op) are rejected here with BR_TRAP_UNSUPPORTED_ABI (trap 17); native 5.0.0 runs them. Confirms AUDIT_ERRATA F9 empirically.
Sources are minified (F10): src/brvm.c on multi-thousand-char lines; GCC emits -Wmisleading-indentation column-tracking NOTES (not errors); build is -Werror clean.
Evidence ledgers are toolchain-bound (F11) but reproduced here (ledger_hash_mismatches=0) because the sandbox matches the sealed reference GCC 13.3 / OpenSSL 3.0.13.

adapters/ are C HAL implementations (posix/file, memory, deterministic, baremetal, smartcard, windows); there is NO Python/FFI binding — drive the node by shelling out to lctl430.py (compile) + brctl-dev (run).
Audit 'make operational = 138 PASS' not printed verbatim; measured 126 named PASS checks / 141 PASS tokens across 12 green suites; authoritative qualify tallies 66/66 and 13/13 reproduced exactly.
package_name: BOTTLE ROCKET 4.7.0 — COLUMNED LCTL Virtual Device, I/O & Service Architecture (61K)

programmatic_drive.compile_cmd: python3 tools/lctl430.py compile SRC.lctlc OUT.brimg --factory [--manifest M.json] [--brir-out B.json]
programmatic_drive.result_parse: stdout is one JSON line {"status":u,"trap":u,"R2":u}; status==2 => HALTED(success), trap==0 => no trap; result = R2 field (= R2.low64, from br_vm_reg(vm,2)[0]). Programs must write R2 for a nonzero value (default boot images write R0 -> R2=0). All caps must be declared in @unit br_request_caps and referenced at capability index 0 (C0:CAP).

runtime_contract: BR/1.1 ISA (marker 21), ABI 2, Device ABI 1.0, LCTLC/1.2 source, BRIM/1 images; 16 wide registers of 1,048,576 bits; 256-word stack; 4096-byte MEM; 8-bit capability gating; 22 services; 14 canonical traps; deterministic wide-state; freestanding C11 core driven through a HAL
